title: “Be the Buyer”—Leveraging the Wisdom of the Crowd in E-Commerce Assortment Planning
eligible_reason: Staggered introduction of crowdvoting across product categories (binary 'after' switching on at category-specific months; csdid shows 10 adoption cohorts g10-g19 over 16 months, 64 categories). Table 3 row 1 reports static TWFE with category and year-month FE, no controls, clustered by category; Table 1 / Figure 2 report Callaway-Sant'Anna (csdid, not-yet-treated) and Table 3 row 2 de Chaisemartin-D'Haultfoeuille (did_multiplegt_dyn) for the same two outcomes.
design_notes: Subscription apparel-rental platform; category-month panel of average rental outcomes. Treatment = category has started using crowdvoting to select items. Item-level analyses (Tables 2, 4, 5, 8) regress item outcomes on prebuy (item bought via crowdvoting) with item characteristics and PSM weights; user-level analyses (Tables 6-7) use prebuy participation with time-varying controls or logit. Only the category-level TWFE/CSA/dCDH specs are staggered DiD.
estimators_reported: item-level OLS with controls and PSM (Tables 2,4,5,8)
n_eligible_specs_note: 2 distinct TWFE specifications (two outcomes); the csdid entries T1_csdid_c1/c2 are the reported CSA versions of the same two designs and are listed for the modern-estimator comparison, not as additional specs.

specs.notes: Modern counterparts reported by the authors: csdid ATT 0.3349 (0.1061) [Table 1 col 1, Figure 2a]; did_multiplegt_dyn average total effect 0.3349 (0.1052) [Table 3 row 2].

ineligible_specs_summary: Tables 2, 4, 5, 8 (main_code.do lines 27-29, 89-91, 118-119, 138-139, 221-223): item-level cross-section regressions of item outcomes on prebuy with item characteristics (is_relaxed ... top_brand, log_retail_price), some with psmatch2 fweights -> not a staggered unit-level adoption design and include controls -> excluded. Table 6 (lines 162-164, 183): user-month panel with prebuy and time-varying control active_day_cnt -> excluded. Table 7 (lines 203-205): logit -> excluded. Table 3 row 3 fect -> synthetic control -> excluded.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: csdid output lists cohorts g10 through g19 (adoption in running_month 10-19) over periods 4-19; counted from main_log.log.
never_treated_note: Unknown: csdid uses notyet; did_multiplegt_dyn shows 47 switchers at horizon 1 among 64 categories, so some categories may be never-treated within the window or adopt at the final month.
data_files_note: No data (strict NDA). Package contains main_code.do, main_log.log (full Stata log with all estimates), main_log_pdf.pdf, table/*.tex, figure/*.pdf. Data files referenced: data/table1_dta.dta (category-month panel), table2_dta.dta, table5_1.dta, table5_2.dta, table6_1.dta, table6_2.dta, table7.dta, table8.dta.
software_note: Stata; reghdfe, csdid, did_multiplegt_dyn, fect, psmatch2, estout.
screener_notes: No article text. Clean eligible design (category x month TWFE, binary absorbing adoption, 10 cohorts) but the analysis data are not shipped; replication requires author cooperation. All published point estimates and SEs are recoverable from main_log.log, so the TWFE-vs-CSA comparison for this paper could be recorded from the log alone (TWFE 0.426 vs CSA 0.335; 0.538 vs 0.471) if the protocol allows log-based entries.
